### Dotplot for enrichment

```{r, echo=F}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

params1 <- params[c("NS_2017","ADHD_2022","BIP_2024","MDD_2025","SCZ_2022")]
names(params1) <- c("Neuroticism", "ADHD", "Bipolar", "MDD", "SCZ")
log_enrich <- do.call(c,lapply(params1, function(x){x$log_enrichment}))
enrich_p <- do.call(c,lapply(params1, function(x){x$enrichment_pval}))
dat <- data.frame(log_enrich=log_enrich, pval=enrich_p, 
           trait=rep(names(params1),each=9), 
           context=rep(sapply(strsplit(names(params1[[1]]$enrichment_pval), "\\|"), function(x) {x[1]}), length(params1)))
dat$log_enrich[dat$log_enrich<0] <- 0
dat$enrichment <- exp(dat$log_enrich)
dat$logP <- -log10(dat$pval)
dat$context <- factor(dat$context, 
                      levels = c(paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_GABA"),
                                 paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_npglut"),
                                 paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_nmglut")))
ggplot(dat, aes(x = context, y = trait)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = enrichment, size = logP),
    shape = 21,            # circle with fill and outline
    color = "grey20",      # border color
    stroke = 0.6,          # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  # Diverging fill scale for enrichment
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", high = "#8B0000",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Enrichment"
  ) +
  # Dot size scale
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 10), name = "-log10(p)") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  ) + 
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_fixed()  # keeps dot aspect circular
ggsave("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/ctwas_enrichment_all_traits.pdf",
       width=6, height=4)

```

### Number of risk genes across traits

```{r,echo=F}
library(ctwas)
ress1 <- ress[c("NS_2017","ADHD_2022","BIP_2024","MDD_2025","SCZ_2022")]
names(ress1) <- c("Neuroticism", "ADHD", "Bipolar", "MDD", "SCZ")
ress2 <- lapply(ress1, function(x) {x$susie_alpha_res[x$susie_alpha_res$type!="SNP",]})
for(t in names(ress2)) {
  ress2[[t]]$genename <- sapply(strsplit(ress2[[t]]$molecular_id, "\\."), 
                                function(x) {x[2]})
}
ress3 <- lapply(ress2, combine_gene_pips, group_by = "genename",by = "context", filter_cs = F, method="combine_cs",include_cs_id = F)

gene5 <- sapply(ress3, function(x) {sum(x$combined_pip>=0.5)})
gene8 <- sapply(ress3, function(x) {sum(x$combined_pip>=0.8)})

dat <- data.frame(N_gene=c(gene8,gene5-gene8),trait=rep(names(gene5),2),
                  type=rep(c("High confidence","Plausible"),each=5))
dat$trait <- factor(dat$trait, levels=c("SCZ","Bipolar","Neuroticism", "MDD", "ADHD"))

type_colors <- c(
  "High confidence" = "#2166AC",  # blue
  "Plausible"       = "#B2182B"   # red
)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = trait, y = N_gene, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "grey20") +   # color adds bar borders
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors, name = "Evidence type") +
  # Add stacked labels (optional)
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(N_gene > 0, N_gene, "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_blank(),  # bold smaller legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),      # place inside panel
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), 
                                   color = "grey60", 
                                   size = 0.4)   # optional: boxed background

  )

ggsave("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/N_risk_genes.pdf",width=4,height=4)

```

### Heatmap for gene PIP across contexts for SCZ

#### High confidence genes (PIP>80%)

```{r, echo=F}
library(pheatmap)
scz <- ress3[["SCZ"]]
scz1 <- scz[scz$combined_pip>0.8,]
scz1[is.na(scz1)] <- 0
pip.dynamic <- rowSums(scz1[,6:11])
pip.static <- rowSums(scz1[,3:5])
dynamic <- pip.dynamic - pip.static>0.5
scz1$type <- dynamic
rownames(scz1) <- scz1$genename

ann_col <- scz1[,12,drop=F]
ann_col$type[ann_col$type] <- "dynamic"
ann_col$type[ann_col$type==FALSE] <- "static"
dat <- scz1[order(scz1$combined_pip, decreasing = T),3:11]
ann_colors <- list(type=c("dynamic"="#008080","static"="#FF7F00"))
ph <- pheatmap(t(dat), cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, 
         color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100), 
         annotation_col = ann_col, annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         angle_col = 315, width = 6, height=3)

ph


library(grid)
pdf("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/SCZ_PIP8_heatmap.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
grid.draw(ph)
dev.off()


```

### Comparison with GTEx brain tissues

#### Cutoff at PIP>50% for both neuront stimulation and GTEx brain tissues

```{r,echo=F}
library(VennDiagram)

gtex.res <- readRDS("data/SCZ_GTEx_brain_cTWAS_geneSymbol_res.rds")
gtex5 <- lapply(gtex.res, function(x){x$hgnc_symbol[x$susie_pip>0.5]})
gtex8 <- lapply(gtex.res, function(x){x$hgnc_symbol[x$susie_pip>0.8]})
univ5 <- unique(do.call(c,gtex5))
univ8 <- unique(do.call(c,gtex8))
scz5 <- ress3[["SCZ"]]$genename[ress3[["SCZ"]]$combined_pip>0.5]
scz8 <- ress3[["SCZ"]]$genename[ress3[["SCZ"]]$combined_pip>0.8]


p1 <- venn.diagram(list(neuron_stim=scz5, 
                  `GTEX_union`=univ5, 
                  `GTEX_prefrontal_cortex`=gtex5[["Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9"]]),
             filename = NULL)


fill_cols <- c("#4DA3D9", "#90C27C", "#F4A259")  # blue, green, orange
line_cols <- rep("#3A3A3A", 3)

venn5 <- venn.diagram(
  x = list(neuron_stim=scz5, 
          `GTEX_union`=univ5, 
          `GTEX_prefrontal_cortex`=gtex5[["Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9"]]),
  filename = NULL,                 # return a grob so we can draw/save
  # Fill + borders
  fill = fill_cols,
  alpha = 0.55,
  lwd = 0.8,
  lty = "solid",
  col = line_cols,
  # Main label styling (set names)
  category.names = c("neuron stim", "GTEx Union", "GTEx prefrontal cortex"),
  cex = 1.2,                       # intersection counts font size
  fontface = "plain",
  fontfamily = "sans",
  # Set name label styling
  cat.cex = 1.3,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.fontfamily = "sans",
  cat.col = "#2B2B2B",
  # Nudges to reduce overlap/clutter (tweak if needed)
  cat.pos = c(-20, 20, 0),
  cat.dist = c(0.06, 0.06, 0.06),
  # Remove default shadows
  rotation.degree = 0,
  imagetype = "png",
  # Turn off misc extras
  scaled = FALSE                   # avoid distorted regions; use counts only
)


grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn5)


pdf("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/SCZ_venn_ns_GTEx_pip5.pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn5)
dev.off()
```

### Locus plot for CPT1C


```{r,echo=F}

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)

# Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
parse_region <- function(region_id) {
  parts <- strsplit(region_id, "_")[[1]]
  tibble(
    chrom = parts[1],
    region_start = as.numeric(parts[2]),
    region_end   = as.numeric(parts[3])
  )
}

# Extract timepoint/celltype from `context`, e.g. "0hr_GABA" -> ("0hr","GABA")
extract_context <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      context = as.character(context),
      timepoint_raw = if_else(!is.na(context), sub("_(.*)$", "", context), NA_character_),
      celltype_raw  = if_else(!is.na(context), sub("^(.*)_", "", context), NA_character_)
    )
}

# Main plot -----------------------------------------------------------
locus_plot_no_genetrack <- function(
  df, region_id,
  colors_timepoint = c("0hr" = "#F5C04E", "1hr" = "#FF4D4F", "6hr" = "#8A57FF"),
  shapes_celltype = c("GABA" = 17, "npglut" = 18, "nmglut" = 15),  # triangle, diamond, square
  point_alpha = 0.9,
  size_top = 1.6,
  size_bottom = 1.9,
  snp_color = "grey70",
  snp_alpha = 0.30,
  snp_shape = 16,  # filled circle
  show_vlines = TRUE,
  pip_label_threshold = 0.10,         # 10% threshold -> label points
  label_column_priority = c("gene_name", "molecular_id", "id"),
  label_size = 3.2,
  label_boxpadding = 0.25,
  label_pointpadding = 0.15,
  label_max_overlaps = Inf,
  label_only_bottom = TRUE,           # TRUE: label only cTWAS PIP panel
  label_style = c("label", "text"),   # "label" = geom_label_repel, "text" = geom_text_repel
  legend_side = c("right", "bottom")  # where to place the shared legend
) {
  label_style <- match.arg(label_style)
  legend_side <- match.arg(legend_side)

  reg <- parse_region(region_id)

  df_reg <- df %>%
    filter(region_id == !!region_id) %>%
    extract_context() %>%
    mutate(
      # If you already have p-values, replace these two lines with your column
      pval = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
      neglog10p = -log10(pval),
      pos_mb = pos / 1e6,

      # Define SNP rows. Adjust this if your dataset marks SNPs differently.
      is_snp = tolower(type) == "snp",

      # Normalize celltype to exactly the three categories you use
      celltype = case_when(
        !is.na(celltype_raw) & tolower(celltype_raw) == "gaba"   ~ "GABA",
        !is.na(celltype_raw) & tolower(celltype_raw) == "npglut" ~ "npglut",
        !is.na(celltype_raw) & tolower(celltype_raw) == "nmglut" ~ "nmglut",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # Keep only expected timepoint labels
      timepoint = case_when(
        !is.na(timepoint_raw) & timepoint_raw %in% c("0hr", "1hr", "6hr") ~ timepoint_raw,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # Valid non-SNP rows have both timepoint and celltype present
      valid_non_snp = (!is_snp) & !is.na(timepoint) & !is.na(celltype),

      # Grey layer includes SNPs + any non-SNPs without complete annotations
      grey_layer = is_snp | (!valid_non_snp)
    )

  # ----- Build label data (PIP > threshold), use preferred name + "timepoint celltype"
  label_df <- df_reg %>%
    filter(susie_pip >= pip_label_threshold, !is_snp, !is.na(timepoint), !is.na(celltype)) %>%
    mutate(
      label_base = coalesce(!!!rlang::syms(label_column_priority)),
      label_text = paste0(label_base, ", ", timepoint, " ", celltype)
    ) %>%
    group_by(label_base) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = susie_pip, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  # X-range in MB from region bounds
  xlim_mb <- c(reg$region_start, reg$region_end) / 1e6

  # --- Top panel: GWAS -log10(p)
  g_top <- ggplot(df_reg, aes(x = pos_mb, y = neglog10p)) +
    # Grey layer first (SNPs + incomplete non-SNPs)
    geom_point(
      data = df_reg %>% filter(grey_layer),
      color = snp_color, shape = snp_shape, size = size_top, alpha = snp_alpha
    ) +
    # Colored layer (only fully annotated non-SNPs)
    geom_point(
      data = df_reg %>% filter(valid_non_snp),
      aes(color = timepoint, shape = celltype),
      alpha = point_alpha, size = size_top
    ) +
    {
      if (!label_only_bottom && nrow(label_df) > 0) {
        if (label_style == "label") {
          list(
            geom_label_repel(
              data = label_df,
              aes(x = pos_mb, y = neglog10p, label = label_text, fill = timepoint),
              min.segment.length = 0, size = label_size,
              box.padding = label_boxpadding, point.padding = label_pointpadding,
              max.overlaps = label_max_overlaps, label.size = 0.25, color = "black"
            ),
            scale_fill_manual(values = colors_timepoint, guide = "none")
          )
        } else {
          geom_text_repel(
            data = label_df,
            aes(x = pos_mb, y = neglog10p, label = label_text),
            min.segment.length = 0, size = label_size,
            box.padding = label_boxpadding, point.padding = label_pointpadding,
            max.overlaps = label_max_overlaps
          )
        }
      } else NULL
    } +
    # panel-local scales (legend suppressed later)
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_timepoint, breaks = c("0hr", "1hr", "6hr"),
                       labels = c("0hr genes", "1hr genes", "6hr genes"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_celltype, breaks = c("GABA", "npglut", "nmglut"),
                       labels = c("GABA genes", "npglut genes", "nmglut genes"), name = NULL) +
    labs(
      y = "GWAS -log\u2081\u2080(p)", x = NULL,
      title = paste0("chr", reg$chrom, " locus: ",
                     comma(reg$region_start), "–", comma(reg$region_end), " bp")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",           # <<< suppress legend here
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim_mb)

  if (show_vlines) {
    g_top <- g_top +
      geom_vline(xintercept = reg$region_start / 1e6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = reg$region_end   / 1e6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50")
  }

  # --- Bottom panel: cTWAS PIP
  g_bottom <- ggplot(df_reg, aes(x = pos_mb, y = susie_pip)) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_reg %>% filter(grey_layer),
      color = snp_color, shape = snp_shape, size = size_bottom, alpha = snp_alpha
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_reg %>% filter(valid_non_snp),
      aes(color = timepoint, shape = celltype),
      alpha = point_alpha, size = size_bottom
    ) +
    {
      if (nrow(label_df) > 0) {
        if (label_style == "label") {
          list(
            geom_label_repel(
              data = label_df,
              aes(x = pos_mb, y = susie_pip, label = label_text, fill = timepoint),
              min.segment.length = 0, size = label_size,
              box.padding = label_boxpadding, point.padding = label_pointpadding,
              max.overlaps = label_max_overlaps, label.size = 0.25, color = "black"
            ),
            scale_fill_manual(values = colors_timepoint, guide = "none")
          )
        } else {
          geom_text_repel(
            data = label_df,
            aes(x = pos_mb, y = susie_pip, label = label_text),
            min.segment.length = 0, size = label_size,
            box.padding = label_boxpadding, point.padding = label_pointpadding,
            max.overlaps = label_max_overlaps
          )
        }
      } else NULL
    } +
    # panel-local scales (legend suppressed later)
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_timepoint, breaks = c("0hr", "1hr", "6hr"),
                       labels = c("0hr genes", "1hr genes", "6hr genes"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_celltype, breaks = c("GABA", "npglut", "nmglut"),
                       labels = c("GABA genes", "npglut genes", "nmglut genes"), name = NULL) +
    labs(y = "cTWAS PIP", x = paste0("chr", reg$chrom, " (MB)")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"            # <<< suppress legend here
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim_mb)

  if (show_vlines) {
    g_bottom <- g_bottom +
      geom_vline(xintercept = reg$region_start / 1e6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = reg$region_end   / 1e6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50")
  }

  # ---- Build one combined legend (Genes: timepoints/colors + contexts/shapes + SNPs)
  legend_df_genes <- df_reg %>% filter(valid_non_snp)
  # Dummy row to force an SNP legend entry even if none in data:
  legend_df_snp <- tibble(
    pos_mb = min(xlim_mb), y = 0,
    timepoint = "SNPs",    # will show under the color portion
    celltype  = NA_character_
  )

  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df_genes, aes(x = pos_mb, y = 0)) +
    # Timepoint/color legend for genes
    geom_point(aes(color = timepoint), shape = 16, size = 3, alpha = 1, show.legend = TRUE) +
    # Celltype/shape legend for genes
    geom_point(aes(shape = celltype), color = "grey20", size = 3, alpha = 1, show.legend = TRUE) +
    # SNP entry (only in the color legend; shape overridden to circle)
    geom_point(
      data = legend_df_snp,
      aes(x = pos_mb, y = y, color = timepoint),
      shape = snp_shape, size = 3, alpha = snp_alpha, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(colors_timepoint, SNPs = snp_color),
      breaks = c("0hr", "1hr", "6hr", "SNPs"),
      labels = c("0hr genes", "1hr genes", "6hr genes", "SNPs"),
      name   = "Time point (Color)"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = shapes_celltype,
      breaks = c("GABA", "npglut", "nmglut", "SNPs"),
      labels = c("GABA genes", "npglut genes", "nmglut genes", "SNPs"),
      name   = "Cell type (shape)"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 16, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

  panels <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    g_top, g_bottom, ncol = 1, align = "v", rel_heights = c(1.1, 0.9)
  )

  if (legend_side == "right") {
    cowplot::plot_grid(panels, shared_legend, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 0.22))
  } else { # bottom
    cowplot::plot_grid(panels, shared_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.18))
  }
}
```

### Dotplot for enrichment

```{r, echo=F}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

params1 <- params[c("NS_2017","ADHD_2022","BIP_2024","MDD_2025","SCZ_2022")]
names(params1) <- c("Neuroticism", "ADHD", "Bipolar", "MDD", "SCZ")
log_enrich <- do.call(c,lapply(params1, function(x){x$log_enrichment}))
enrich_p <- do.call(c,lapply(params1, function(x){x$enrichment_pval}))
dat <- data.frame(log_enrich=log_enrich, pval=enrich_p, 
           trait=rep(names(params1),each=9), 
           context=rep(sapply(strsplit(names(params1[[1]]$enrichment_pval), "\\|"), function(x) {x[1]}), length(params1)))
dat$log_enrich[dat$log_enrich<0] <- 0
dat$enrichment <- exp(dat$log_enrich)
dat$logP <- -log10(dat$pval)
dat$context <- factor(dat$context, 
                      levels = c(paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_GABA"),
                                 paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_npglut"),
                                 paste0(c(0,1,6),"hr_nmglut")))
ggplot(dat, aes(x = context, y = trait)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = enrichment, size = logP),
    shape = 21,            # circle with fill and outline
    color = "grey20",      # border color
    stroke = 0.6,          # border thickness
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  # Diverging fill scale for enrichment
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", high = "#8B0000",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Enrichment"
  ) +
  # Dot size scale
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 10), name = "-log10(p)") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  ) + 
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_fixed()  # keeps dot aspect circular
ggsave("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/ctwas_enrichment_all_traits_caQTL.pdf", width=6, height=4)

```

### Number of risk genes across traits

```{r,echo=F}
library(ctwas)
ress1 <- ress[c("NS_2017","ADHD_2022","BIP_2024","MDD_2025","SCZ_2022")]
names(ress1) <- c("Neuroticism", "ADHD", "Bipolar", "MDD", "SCZ")
ress2 <- lapply(ress1, function(x) {x$susie_alpha_res[x$susie_alpha_res$type!="SNP",]})
for(t in names(ress2)) {
  ress2[[t]]$genename <- sapply(strsplit(ress2[[t]]$molecular_id, "\\."), 
                                function(x) {x[2]})
}
ress3 <- lapply(ress2, combine_gene_pips, group_by = "genename",by = "context", filter_cs = F, method="combine_cs",include_cs_id = F)

gene5 <- sapply(ress3, function(x) {sum(x$combined_pip>=0.5)})
gene8 <- sapply(ress3, function(x) {sum(x$combined_pip>=0.8)})

dat <- data.frame(N_gene=c(gene8,gene5-gene8),trait=rep(names(gene5),2),
                  type=rep(c("High confidence","Plausible"),each=5))
dat$trait <- factor(dat$trait, levels=c("SCZ","Bipolar","Neuroticism", "MDD", "ADHD"))

type_colors <- c(
  "High confidence" = "#2166AC",  # blue
  "Plausible"       = "#B2182B"   # red
)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = trait, y = N_gene, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "grey20") +   # color adds bar borders
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_colors, name = "Evidence type") +
  # Add stacked labels (optional)
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(N_gene > 0, N_gene, "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_blank(),  # bold smaller legend title
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),      # place inside panel
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), 
                                   color = "grey60", 
                                   size = 0.4)   # optional: boxed background

  )

ggsave("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/N_risk_genes_caQTL.pdf",width=4,height=4)

```

### Heritability of caQTL vs. eQTL

```{r,echo=F}
res.store <- "/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/ctwas_new_res/caQTL/"
paramfs <- list.files(res.store,pattern="parameters",full.names = T)
params.c <- list()
for (f in paramfs) {
  n <- substr(basename(f), 1, nchar(basename(f))-15)
  params.c[[n]] <- readRDS(f)
}

res.store <- "/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/ctwas_new_res/eQTL/"
paramfs <- list.files(res.store,pattern="parameters",full.names = T)
params.e <- list()
for (f in paramfs) {
  n <- substr(basename(f), 1, nchar(basename(f))-15)
  params.e[[n]] <- readRDS(f)
}

he <-sapply(params.e, function(x) {sum(x$prop_heritability[-10])})[c(1,3,4,5,7)]
hc <-sapply(params.c, function(x) {sum(x$prop_heritability[-10])})[c(1,3,4,5,7)]

names(he) <- c("ADHD","Bipolar","Depression","Neuroticism","SCZ")
names(hc) <- names(he)

dat <- data.frame(value=c(hc,he), trait=rep(names(he),2),
                  type=rep(c("caQTL & ASoC","eQTL"),each=5))


library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = trait, y = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.7, color = "grey20") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(value, accuracy = 0.1)),
    position = pd,
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,      # centered inside the bar
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    hjust=1.1
  ) +
  labs(x = "Trait", y = "Value (%)", fill = "QTL group") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("/Users/lifanliang/Documents/neuron_stim/revision/ctwas_res/h2g_caqtl_vs_eqtl.pdf",
       width=3.5, height=6)
```
